[World Day of Remembrance: Honoring Lives Lost on Our Roads November 10, 2026](https://www.verramobility.com/world-day-of-remembrance-2027/)


Verra Mobility has received the “Legacy Modernization Innovation Award” in the 2026[GovTech Breakthrough Awards](https://govtechbreakthrough.com/) program, recognizing our innovative approach to modernizing government transportation systems.


The GovTech Breakthrough Awards recognize leading companies, technologies, and products transforming how government agencies operate and deliver services. The 2026 program received hundreds of nominations from companies in more than 15 countries, spanning innovations in public safety, government cloud technology, cybersecurity, and more.


**Advancing Innovation in Government Technology**


Our approach to technology innovation is rooted in understanding the operational challenges facing government agencies and developing solutions that address their evolving needs. By combining decades of transportation industry experience with modern technology, we’re helping agencies move beyond traditional legacy systems to improve efficiency, strengthen security, and adapt more easily to changing requirements.


“Modernizing government technology requires more than upgrading legacy systems. It requires rethinking how those systems are built,” said **Jason Rivera, chief technology officer, Verra Mobility** . “With AXIS 2.0, we’ve developed a cloud-native, configuration-driven platform that gives agencies greater flexibility to adapt to changing requirements without extensive software customization. This recognition reflects our commitment to building secure, scalable technology that simplifies operations and provides a foundation for continued innovation.”


**Helping Government Agencies Move Beyond Legacy Systems**


Our AXIS 2.0 platform was recognized for reimagining how transportation technology is designed, deployed and maintained. The platform enables government agencies to configure workflows, business rules and reporting requirements to meet their unique needs. Dedicated cloud environments and enhanced security capabilities provide a more resilient technology foundation while allowing agencies to implement operational and legislative changes more efficiently.


The award reflects our continued leadership in developing innovative transportation solutions that help government agencies operate more efficiently, respond to evolving community needs and advance road safety.
